company-deep-analysis v1.0.0 – Initial public release

- Supports deep analysis of A/H-share companies: data collection, profiling, industry chain (Porter Five Forces), moat, financials, relative valuation.
- Produces two outputs by default: a detailed Markdown report and an HTML investment brief.
- Flexible single-step mode: users can request specific sections like “financial analysis” or “company profile,” outputting only relevant files.
- Intelligent routing recognizes keywords and market scope (A/H only); non-listed or US-listed companies are filtered out.
- Data collection integrates multiple sources (财报/F10/研报/板块/一致预期) with data quality checks and clear error handling.
- Ensures each report includes conclusions first, correct data attribution, and clear disclosure of any blind spots or uncertainties.
